mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_collect WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND collect_type = #{collectType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_collect (user_id, collect_type, target_id, is_cancel, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{collectType}, #{targetId}, #{isCancel}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_collect SET is_cancel = #{isCancel}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collect c JOIN news n ON n.id = c.target_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.collect_type = 1 AND c.is_cancel = 0 AND (c.is_deleted IS NULL OR c.is_deleted = 0) AND (n.is_deleted IS NULL OR n.is_deleted = '0')

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, u.avatar, u.user_account AS userAccount, n.like_count, n.comment_count, n.collect_count, n.create_time, (SELECT ni.image_url FROM news_image ni WHERE ni.news_id = n.id ORDER BY ni.sort_order ASC, ni.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS cover FROM user_collect c JOIN news n ON n.id = c.target_id JOIN user u ON u.id = n.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.collect_type = 1 AND c.is_cancel = 0 AND (c.is_deleted IS NULL OR c.is_deleted = 0) AND (n.is_deleted IS NULL OR n.is_deleted = '0') AND (u.is_deleted IS NULL OR u.is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collect c JOIN comment cm ON cm.id = c.target_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.collect_type = 2 AND c.is_cancel = 0 AND (c.is_deleted IS NULL OR c.is_deleted = 0) AND (cm.status IS NULL OR cm.status = 1)

SELECT cm.id, u.username, cm.content, cm.like_count, cm.news_id, cm.create_time, n.title AS post_title FROM user_collect c JOIN comment cm ON cm.id = c.target_id LEFT JOIN news n ON n.id = cm.news_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = cm.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.collect_type = 2 AND c.is_cancel = 0 AND (c.is_deleted IS NULL OR c.is_deleted = 0) AND (cm.status IS NULL OR cm.status = 1) ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
